about.title: About me
about.p1: I'm an Informatics student at Centro Educativo Tecnico Laboral Kinal, focused on web application development. I'm interested in building functional solutions that solve real problems.
about.p2: Currently in my final year of high school, where I've developed projects such as banking management systems, restaurant platforms, and parking solutions. Each project has allowed me to learn about software architecture, databases, and teamwork.
about.p3: My goal is to enter the workforce as a developer, keep growing technically, and bring value to the team that welcomes me.
